body:
The session added auto-exploration to escher-driver: one in-process library call, escher_driver::explore, explores the available actions breadth-first within a step budget (StepBudget, 1 to MAX_EXPLORE_STEPS 10,000), each path on a fresh session, every call through Session::run, the last call under a panic catch.
A path ends in a closed ending (accepted with settled, refused with its cause, panicked, diverged at a step); the report holds closed words, indices, calls and bools only, no panic payload, node id, screen text or digest, and is never logged or printed.
The verbs explored are the action table's target verbs whose result holds no image field, read by the field's kind (today click, type, scroll; screenshot left out); exploration opens no span and emits no event of its own, each driven call leaves its own command span.
Explored paths can be kept as replayable checks into a recording directory, refused as record-dir-not-private before anything boots when the directory is open to group or others; a path deeper than a kept check's 400 records ends its recording and that check is removed.
The kept check's opening record gained a third key, format, written 1 and read strictly (absent read as 1, any other value refused malformed holding nothing of the bytes); the two committed checks were re-recorded and differ by that key alone.
Measured: an unbounded app (the Counter) never exhausts the frontier; exhaustion is witnessed on a finite refusing-control page. No verb, role, tool, cause, exit, env var, span, span field, log site, metric or dependency was added; nothing retired.

body: The kept check file contract (accepted, answer, answer digest, arguments) gains the opening record's key format: the opening record now holds three keys, tool, arguments and format, format written as the whole number 1.

The recording file's check-{n}.json contract: each check opens with the record carrying format 1; a check without format reads as format 1; any other value (2, 1.0, "1", -1, 1.5, 0, null, true) refuses the whole check.
The refusal cause malformed gains a new trigger, a kept check whose format is not the whole number 1, and the refusal holds nothing of the check's bytes.

Committed kept checks hold no secrets and no private data: the two committed Counter checks were re-recorded by the binary and differ only by the format key; no scrub, redaction or violation shape moved.

Recording directory private and the record-dir-not-private refusal: the exploration's record directory is checked first and refused with SessionError RecordDirNotPrivate before any boot, nothing written.
Recording bounds: a kept check's 400-record bound now also ends an explored path's recording deeper than it, and that path's check is removed; the bound's value itself unchanged.

One span per driver command and no call content in the command span: indirect, exploration runs every call through Session::run, so each driven call leaves its own command span and the exploration adds none.
Driver emits no event and installs no subscriber: indirect, the new explore component inside the driver library has no tracing, print, log site or env read.
Hosted call runs through the session's run alone: exploration is a second in-process caller that drives every call, re-reach steps included, through Session::run.

escher-telemetry panic event and panic hook with previous hook: a panic in an explored call is caught by the exploration and recorded as a Panicked ending, while the process's panic hook still runs for it.
Answer-bearing types never logged and session logs carry no page content: the new exploration report types hold no screen text or payload and are never logged or printed.
Actions read changes nothing in the document: exploration reads the actions answer on each newly reached screen to expand its children, a new reader of that rule.

Capability statement updated by hand: an exploration section, its in-process-only absence and the 400-record limit were added; its five counts (verbs fourteen, causes eight, MCP tools fourteen) unchanged.
Cold-agent kept checks held at rest only and stay local: kept checks of explored paths share the same owner-only medium and are written only into the caller's directory.

body_fields.fact: Auto-exploration (escher_driver::explore) opens no span and emits no event of its own; each call it drives leaves its own command span, re-reach steps included.

The exploration report (Exploration, ExploredPath, PathEnding) holds closed endings, indices, calls and bools only, no panic payload, node id, screen text or screen digest, and is never logged or printed.

A panic in an explored call is caught by the exploration and reported as the closed ending Panicked holding no payload; the process's panic hook still runs, and the session it struck is dropped under a second catch.
The kept check's opening record carries format, the whole number 1 (CHECK_FORMAT); absent read as 1, any other value refuses the check malformed holding nothing of its bytes.
An exploration given a recording directory keeps one check per explored path there, refused record-dir-not-private before any boot when the directory is open to group or others.

body_fields.because: The chunk adds the exploration report, whose closed content is a privacy promise its checks hold.

body_fields.promise: A panic in a handler during exploration is caught, the panicked session dropped under a second catch, and the exploration goes on; the next boot on the thread answers.
body_fields.because: The chunk adds panic catching to exploration, held by its panicking-handler check.

body_fields.name: Explored verbs chosen by result field kind
body_fields.rule: Exploration explores the verb table's target verbs whose result holds no image field, chosen by the field's kind and never by its name, so screenshot is never explored.
body_fields.because: The chunk chooses the explored verbs by result field kind, a selection rule future verbs fall under.

body_fields.promise: With a recording directory an exploration keeps one check per path, each check's calls equal to its path's answered calls and replaying green; a panicked path's check holds the steps before the panic.
body_fields.because: The chunk records each explored path as a kept check, a promise its recording checks hold.

body_fields.promise: A kept check's opening record carries format, written as the integer 1; a check without format reads as format 1, and any other value refuses the check as malformed holding nothing of its bytes.
body_fields.because: The kept check's form gains the opening record's format key, written and read strictly.

body_fields.name: Exploration exhaustion asserted on a finite page
body_fields.rule: Exhaustion of an exploration's frontier is asserted only on a finite fixture page; an exploration of the Counter asserts exhausted false.
body_fields.why: An unbounded app never exhausts a breadth-first frontier.
body_fields.because: The plan's premise that the Counter exhausts was measured false, so the test strategy moved exhaustion to a finite page.

body_fields.capability: Exploration reached through a driver verb, role, argument or carrier
body_fields.because: The founder ruled exploration in process only, so no carrier reaches it.
The founder answered that exploration follows no navigation, ratified rather than provisional.

body:
Added auto-exploration to the driver: one in-process library call that explores the available actions breadth-first, within a step budget, on a fresh session for each path.
Every call it drives goes through the session's own validation. A panic in a handler is caught for each path. Refused, panicked and diverged paths are never extended.
It can keep each explored path as a replayable kept check in a recording directory that must be owner-only. A directory open to the group or to others is refused before anything boots.
The kept check's opening record gained a third key, format. It is written as 1, read as 1 when absent, and any other value is refused as malformed. The two committed Counter checks were re-recorded with that key alone.
No verb, role, argument, carrier, IPC method, socket, env var, refusal cause, session error, log site or span was added. No dependency moved. Nothing was retired.
The founder confirmed in his own words that exploration is in process only and crosses no carrier. The absence of navigation-following stays provisional.

body_fields.what: the driver's in-process auto-exploration: the step budget, the closed path endings, a fresh session per path, the panic catch, and the explored verbs taken from the actions table with image-result verbs left out
unit tests of the exploration step budget bound and of the explored-verb selection by result field kind

the stand tests of auto-exploration: every served task within budget, a refusing control, a caught panicking handler, each path's kept check replaying green, the group-open recording directory refused, the budget bounding every acting call

the actions answer and the driver verb table's target verbs and per-node call naming, now visible within the crate to exploration
the kept check recorder and its strict reader of untrusted check bytes, the opening start record now writing and strictly reading the format key
unit tests of the recorded check file's form and its strict reader, including the format rows that are read and those refused as malformed
a committed stand-Counter kept check recorded through the command line, now holding format 1 in its opening record
a committed stand-Counter kept check recorded through the MCP server, now holding format 1 in its opening record
the committed capability statement of the driver's carriers and limits, now stating that exploration runs in process only and the kept-check record limit for an explored path

body: The kept check file's opening start record goes from two keys (tool, arguments) to three (tool, arguments, format). A row that states the start record's keys or the kept check file's contents is now stale.

The rules that a recorded check is read strictly and treated as untrusted bytes gain a new strict field. format must be the JSON integer 1. Anything else (1.0, "1", -1, 0, 1.5, null, true, or another number) is refused as malformed, and the refusal holds nothing of the bytes.
The rules that coverage and every other check reader refuse an unusable check as malformed now cover a format mismatch too, through the same reader.
The committed stand-Counter checks decision: both committed checks were re-recorded by the binary and differ from before only by the format key.

The recording directory is owner-only and kept checks are owner-only, under the kept check medium contract. Exploration is a new caller that records into such a directory. It refuses a group- or other-open directory with the existing record-dir-not-private session error before anything boots, and writes nothing.

The recording bounds that end a recording, and the rule that the recorder removes only its own files: an explored path deeper than a kept check's 400 records ends its recording, and that path's check is removed.
One validation path for every carrier, and the single command validation gate: exploration drives every call through the session's run and validate, so it adds no second validation path.

The closed driver verb schema and the driver verb contracts: no verb, role, argument or carrier reaches exploration. It sits beside the absence of a URL-taking driver verb as a further capability that the carriers do not carry.

The screenshot carried in band, and the screenshot answer's png: exploration leaves out every verb whose result holds an image field. It goes by the field's kind, not its name, which today leaves out screenshot.

No panic on call-supplied input: exploration runs each path's last call inside a panic catch. A path whose handler panics ends as Panicked, the session is dropped under a second catch, and the exploration goes on.
The rules that no NodeId is kept between calls and that no process-local handle crosses: the exploration report holds no NodeId, panic payload, screen text or screen digest.

Driver outcomes are never logged, screen content stays out of logs, there is one command span per call, and the driver installs no subscriber and reads no env. Exploration adds no span, field, log site, print or env read. Each call it drives leaves only its own command span.
Recorded type to a masked control stays masked, and no caller input is echoed: the text typed on an explored path is only the fixed in-bound values that the per-node call naming gives.

Actions read changes nothing, and the actions answer: exploration reads the actions answer on each new screen to choose its children. It is a second in-crate caller of the target verbs and the call naming.

The session errors as one fixed table, and the closed refusal cause set: exploration reuses the existing session error and the eight causes, and adds none. A refused path's ending holds the closed cause.

body_fields.fact: An exploration's step budget is a whole number from 1 to 10,000 (MAX_EXPLORE_STEPS). 0 or more than the bound gives no budget. The budget bounds every acting call the exploration runs, re-reach steps included. The first screen is read unrecorded and costs no step.

A kept check's opening record carries format, written as 1. A check without the key is read as format 1. Any other value, of whatever JSON type, is refused as malformed, and the refusal holds nothing of the bytes.

Exploration explores only the driver table's target verbs whose result holds no image field, chosen by the field's kind and never by its name, so today screenshot is left out. The text typed on a path is only the fixed in-bound value that the call naming gives.

An exploration's report holds only closed endings, indices, calls and bools: Accepted with settled, Refused with its cause, Panicked, or Diverged at a step. It holds no panic payload, NodeId, screen text or screen digest, and it is never logged or printed.

An exploration keeps each explored path as a kept check only in an owner-only recording directory. A group- or other-open directory is refused as record-dir-not-private before anything boots, with nothing written. A path deeper than a kept check's 400 records ends its recording, and that check is removed.

During exploration, a handler panic is caught for each path, which ends as Panicked. The session is dropped under a second catch, and the exploration goes on with the next path. A refused, panicked or diverged path is never extended.
Exploration is reachable on no carrier. No verb, role, argument, socket request or MCP tool reaches it, and it is one in-process library call only. This is ratified by the founder, not provisional.
Exploration follows no navigation: it drives only the in-page actions of the screen it boots on. This stands PROVISIONAL, pending the founder's choice.
Exploration emits no span, field or log line of its own. Each call it drives leaves only that call's own command span.

An exploration's step budget is a whole number from 1 to 10,000 acting calls, re-reach steps counted; 0 or past 10,000 is no budget.

A path ends Accepted (settled or not), Refused with its cause, Panicked, or Diverged at a step; a refused, panicked or diverged path is never expanded, and the report holds no panic payload, node id, screen text or digest.

With a recording directory an exploration keeps one check per path, each check's calls equal to its path's answered calls and replaying green; a panicked path's check holds the steps before the panic.

A control that removes a bound loosens it (to twice the budget) rather than removing it, so the mutated run stays bounded.
